{'text': 'Apple today released an updated version of its "Apple Invites" app for iPhone. This update brings new features from iOS 27, such as improved photo sharing capabilities and Image Playground enhancements.', 'rewrites': [{'text': '蘋果公司今日為 iPhone 推出咗新版嘅「Apple Invites」應用程式。今次更新加入咗 iOS 27 嘅全新特性，例如提升咗相片分享功能以及 Image Playground 嘅能力。', 'summary': '將英文新聞翻譯為香港繁體中文'}]}

{'text': 'Here is Apple\'s full release notes for "Apple Invites" today:', 'rewrites': [{'text': '以下係 Apple 今日對「Apple Invites」嘅完整更新日誌：', 'summary': '將英文新聞翻譯為香港繁體中文'}]}

  • {'text': 'Shared albums now support full-resolution sharing, allowing you to relive every detail of your moments in the app. Anyone can contribute and share photos, even those without an Apple device.', 'rewrites': [{'text': '共享相簿而家支援全解像度分享，等你可以喺 app 入面重溫每個時刻嘅精彩細節。任何人都可以加入並分享相片，即使冇 Apple 裝置嘅用戶亦都一樣得。', 'summary': '將英文新聞翻譯為香港繁體中文'}]}
  • {'text': 'Image Playground can now help you create high-quality backgrounds in a variety of styles, including ultra-realistic styles, to perfectly capture the mood you want for your invitations.', 'rewrites': [{'text': 'Image Playground 而家可以幫你製作出各種風格嘅高品質背景，包括超寫實風格，等你嘅邀請函可以完美呈現你想要嘅氛圍。', 'summary': '將英文新聞翻譯為香港繁體中文'}]}
  • {'text': 'Guests who need to verify their email can now do so by tapping a link in their inbox, no longer needing to enter a verification code, making it easier to attend events.', 'rewrites': [{'text': '需要驗證電郵嘅賓客，而家可以喺信箱入面㩒個連結就搞掂，唔使再輸入驗證碼，參加活動更加方便。', 'summary': '將英文新聞翻譯為香港繁體中文'}]}
  • {'text': 'This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements.', 'rewrites': [{'text': '今次更新包含錯誤修復以及效能改善。', 'summary': '將英文新聞翻譯為香港繁體中文'}]}

{'text': 'You can download "Apple Invites" from the App Store. Creating an invitation requires an iCloud+ subscription, but anyone can reply to an invitation.', 'rewrites': [{'text': '你可以喺 App Store 下載「Apple Invites」。建立邀請函需要訂閱 iCloud+，但任何人都可以回覆邀請。', 'summary': '將英文新聞翻譯為香港繁體中文'}]}
